notes.content:
Hi Guys. Have you seen my new game? 🤔
The demo version of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553320/Them/]THEM [/url][/b]will be released in a few hours. Get ready for a different kind of game! 😁🎮

notes.title: New game is coming!
notes.content:
Hi guys. There are only a few hours left until the release of the first chapter of my new game titled [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331450/A_Hole_In_My_Room/]A Hole in My Room[/url][/b] on Steam 😱🎮 This game was supposed to be part of the [b]Silence Channel[/b] before, but due to the art style and some differences in gameplay, I tried to release it under a different title. I hope you enjoy it. I'm looking forward to your comments, and don't forget to add the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b]. doing this really helps me a lot in completing the game 🙏

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331450/A_Hole_In_My_Room/][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42935968/c5192ca5a5e2f0550c85030a405ee232e10289ff.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 0.46 is available! 😱
notes.content:
Hi Guys! As I promised, Update 4.6 is ready and you can now get this update 😱
Here you can see the list of added features in this update.

[list]
[b][*] Story Chapter 4 unlocked!
[*] New Challenge Mod
[*] Six New Achievements
[*] Xbox controllers support
[*] Ukrainian Language (UI+Subtitle)
[*] Some minor bugs fixed[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42935968/707456c9f1cb9e1d76aba3fc69d54a8ff27f17d2.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates! 😁 I am trying to add more features to the game (Story Chapters, New Challenges, Puzzles...) Maybe you'll find it exciting. I'm looking forward to your comments.

notes.content:

Stay tuned for the fourth chapter and the revelation of hidden secrets in the game's story 😱

notes.title: Update 0.452
notes.content:
Hi guys, as promised, the new update is ready! we have added some of the features you requested in this update 😉✌️ Thank you for supporting us 🙏

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42935968/d7c17be2958b66e15f9c5dcc80ec551e97e62448.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]4 New Languages added (Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Korean)[/b]
[*] [b]Achievements now available on easy mod[/b]
[*] [b]Game volume slider added to game settings[/b]
[*] [b]Reset Default controller button added to game settings[/b]
[*] [b]Customization keyboard problem fixed[/b]
[*] [b]Pills collected save system added[/b]
[*] [b]Weapon Reload system is faster now[/b]
[*] [b]Loading freezing problem fixed[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Thanks Guys 😉
notes.content:
Hi guys, we are glad that the Silence Channel 2 has attracted your attention 😍 and we have plans to update the game and add more languages and interesting parts to the game, which will be announced soon, and of course, extra story parts are also supposed to be added to the game. Also, be sure to leave us a comment and send us your youtube gameplay videos. We enjoy watching your streams and add them to our channels ✌️ Thank you for supporting us 🙏

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42935968/0408fccc87de9a304442787656eeef925f915217.png[/img]
